BiblicalUsage: Meshillemoth is the name of two Israelites, a father in Ephraim and a father in the priestly line. 2 Chronicles 28:12 names Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth among the heads of Ephraim who stood against the captives being brought in, and Nehemiah 11:13 traces Amashai through Meshillemoth the son of Immer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Meshillemoths show the same name in two callings: one who stood for mercy, and one who fathered priests.
